heading: TN Solidarity Summit 2026
intro: Everything you need to know about the Tennessee Solidarity Summit — September 18–20, 2026, at Neshoba Unitarian Universalist Church in Cordova (Memphis), Tennessee.

faq.question: Who can I contact to find out more about TUUCAN and the TN Solidarity Summit?
Where is Neshoba Church?
faq.answer: Neshoba Unitarian Universalist Church is in Cordova, TN, west of downtown Memphis and Interstate 240, near Shelby Farms Park (7350 Raleigh Lagrange Rd, Cordova, TN 38018).

hotels.heading: Nearby Hotels
hotels.intro: Hotels are organized by their proximity to Neshoba Church. All prices are approximate starting rates.

clusters.name: Near Germantown Road and Wolf River Blvd
clusters.description: This upscale, commercial hub sits directly south of the church. These options provide quick access to medical centers, shopping districts, and dining.

hotels.name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Memphis-Germantown
hotels.description: An extended-stay 3-star property featuring full in-room kitchens, free hot breakfast, and an outdoor pool.

hotels.name: Courtyard by Marriott Memphis Germantown
hotels.description: A modern 3-star hotel with newly renovated rooms, an indoor pool, and an on-site American restaurant.

hotels.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Memphis/Germantown
hotels.description: A highly-rated 2-star hotel praised for its safety, cleanliness, free hot breakfast, and indoor heated pool.

hotels.name: Quality Inn & Suites Germantown North
hotels.description: A budget-friendly 3-star alternative that offers free breakfast, free parking, and a heated indoor pool.

clusters.name: Near I-40 and Sycamore View Rd
clusters.description: This junction sits northwest of the church and provides immediate interstate accessibility. These properties are highly functional for commuters and road trippers.

hotels.name: Wingate by Wyndham Memphis East
hotels.description: A well-regarded 3-star hotel with a fitness center, free continental breakfast, and highly rated staff.

hotels.name: AmericInn by Wyndham Memphis East
hotels.description: A straightforward 3-star hotel off I-40 that includes an indoor pool, a hot tub, and free high-speed Wi-Fi.

hotels.name: Comfort Inn & Suites Memphis East
hotels.description: Positioned right off the expressway near several walkable dining options, offering an indoor pool and free breakfast.

clusters.name: Near Poplar Ave & Germantown Rd
clusters.description: Slightly further south along Germantown Road toward Poplar Avenue — still roughly a 10-minute drive — you will find another dense pocket of premium lodging options.

hotels.name: TownePlace Suites by Marriott Memphis Germantown
hotels.description: An excellent all-suite, pet-friendly option equipped with fully functional kitchen units.

hotels.name: Hampton Inn & Suites Memphis Germantown
hotels.description: A highly rated 3-star location offering free breakfast, a seasonal outdoor pool, and a gym.
